inputs.text: phone photo, close-up front camera selfie of a 24-year-old Costa Rican woman sitting in the passenger seat of a car, phone held slightly above at arm's length, head tilted, face filling most of the frame. Long straight black hair, slightly messy, with flyaway strands over her shoulders. Light tan skin with visible pores, a few tiny blemishes, natural shine on her nose and forehead, rosy flushed cheeks, pink tinted lip balm, small silver hoop earring. Soft closed-mouth smile, relaxed eyes looking into the camera. Light gray ribbed tank top. Through the car window behind her: a rural road in Costa Rica with banana plants and a small colorful house. Warm afternoon daylight from the window on one side of her face, the other side in soft shadow. iPhone front camera, slight wide-angle distortion, soft focus, mild noise, slightly blown highlights, unedited. instagram photo from 2023.
